decision: Spike harness in isolated spikes/flowable-oss/: two independent docker-compose stacks (flowable, operaton), each = OSS REST app (pinned Apache-2.0 image) + disposable Postgres 16 with a named volume. A single zero-dep bash entrypoint run.sh with per-AC subcommands (up/license/seed/cleanup/deadletter/measure/down/smoke/all), parameterized by ENGINE and N_HISTORY (default 300000). History is seeded by direct batched INSERT into the engine history tables via psql (generate_series, 10k batches; starting REST instances for 300k would take hours) using a minimal-but-correct completed-instance model. Cleanup is measured on a warm run (warm-up + delete-throughput records/s + table-growth curve before/during/after) with explicitly written 70M/year extrapolation assumptions. Deadletter is created deterministically: deploy a minimal failing-service-task BPMN, drive retries to 0 so the job lands in deadletter, then run list/set-retries/move ONLY through the artifact's public OSS REST and record HTTP code + effect. All measurements go to machine-readable measurements.json per engine. Verdict = docs/design/stack-flowable-oss-spike-addendum.md, status 'addendum, awaiting ratification'. BUILD-phase fitness functions verify the harness works (smoke), not the spike's numbers (those feed the founder ratification gate, not a CI gate). Runtime target: local Docker on the dev machine; no external resource / founder provision (public docker pull of Apache-2.0 images).

rejected_alternatives.option: Seed 300k completed instances by starting+completing them through the engine REST API
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Hours on a laptop and adds runtime noise to the cleanup throughput measurement; the spike needs history rows in the correct shape, not execution semantics (out-of-scope per spec section 4). Direct batched INSERT into ACT_HI_* is minutes; the assumption 'inserted history deletes like engine-produced history' is written into the journal/addendum and is checked by cleanup actually shrinking the row count (AC-4/AC-6).

rejected_alternatives.option: Build a thin custom Dockerfile from Flowable maven artifacts for a Flowable 7 REST app
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Unnecessary: the official flowable/flowable-rest:7.1.0 OSS image (Apache 2.0) already ships the full REST API + Swagger including /management deadletter endpoints and supports Postgres via SPRING_DATASOURCE_* env. Risk R1 is retired; a custom build would add a non-reproducible moving part.

rejected_alternatives.option: Run the spike as part of the product unit-CI on every push
rejected_alternatives.why_not: The spike is manual/fitness by nature (spec section 5): it needs a Docker daemon, pulls hundreds of MB of images, and at full N>=300k runs for minutes per engine. CI-gating prod builds on it violates NF-5 isolation and would couple Choros CI to an engine spike. Fitness functions instead run as a local gate prologue (smoke at small N) and the full run is an explicit BUILD execution step whose output is the journal + addendum read by the founder.

rejected_alternatives.option: One shared compose stack hosting both Flowable and Operaton against one Postgres
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Schema collisions (both engines use ACT_* tables) and cross-engine contamination would make license/throughput/deadletter measurements non-attributable and non-idempotent (NF-2). Two fully independent compose projects with separate volumes and host ports keep each engine's verdict clean.

fields.name: extrapolation
fields.type: object {linearity, contour_fraction, dev_factor, window, fits_70m, headroom_factor}

contracts: run.sh up <engine>            -> bring stack up from pinned public OSS image, wait healthcheck green (AC-1)
run.sh license <engine>      -> record image coordinate + sha256 digest + license string; license_ok bool (AC-2/11, RL-3 binary)
run.sh seed <engine> [N=300000] -> batched INSERT into engine history tables, return actual count (AC-3)
run.sh cleanup <engine>      -> enable OSS history-cleanup, warm-up, measure delete throughput + degradation curve (AC-4/5/6)
run.sh deadletter <engine>   -> deploy failing BPMN, drive job to deadletter, run list/set-retries/move via OSS REST, record http+effect (AC-7/8/9)
run.sh measure <engine>      -> assemble EngineResult into measurements.json (AC-12)
run.sh down <engine>         -> tear down containers + disposable volume (AC-15)
run.sh smoke <engine>        -> fast BUILD-fitness path: up -> REST 200 -> seed 1000 -> measure writes JSON -> down
measurements.json            -> { schema_version, generated_at, engines: EngineResult[] } (machine-readable, committed as evidence)
Operaton REST OSS: GET /engine-rest/job?withException=true ; PUT /engine-rest/job/{id}/retries {retries:n} ; POST /engine-rest/history/cleanup?immediatelyDue=true
Exact REST paths confirmed against the running artifact's Swagger UI in BUILD, not invented

fitness_functions.rule: Spike touches no src/, prod docker-compose, or prod CI; all changes under spikes/ plus the one docs/design addendum and this ADR (AC-14/NF-5)
fitness_functions.ci_check: git diff --name-only <base>..HEAD | grep -vE '^(spikes/|docs/design/stack-flowable-oss-spike-addendum\.md|docs/design/T-0117)' must be empty, else exit 1

fitness_functions.rule: Each stack comes up from public images and REST answers 200 (AC-1)
fitness_functions.ci_check: spikes/flowable-oss/run.sh up flowable && curl -fsS localhost:8080/flowable-rest/service/management/engine >/dev/null (and operaton on 8081); exit 0

fitness_functions.rule: Generator loads the requested volume and actual count matches target (AC-3, small N in smoke)
fitness_functions.ci_check: run.sh seed flowable 1000 && test "$(psql -tA -c 'select count(*) from act_hi_procinst')" -ge 1000

fitness_functions.rule: measure produces measurements.json that is valid JSON with required EngineResult fields (AC-12)
down removes containers and the disposable volume; a repeat up is clean (AC-15/NF-2)
fitness_functions.ci_check: run.sh down flowable && ! docker volume ls | grep -q spike_flowable_pg && run.sh up flowable; exit 0

fitness_functions.rule: Addendum present, status 'addendum, awaiting ratification', has explicit go/no-go for both engines + recommendation (AC-13)
Images pinned (not :latest), Apache 2.0 license recorded in the journal (AC-2/11, NF-2 reproducibility)
No trial keys / tokens / registrations in the harness (RL-3)

traceability.covered_by: ADR section 3 topology + run.sh up + healthcheck; FF-SMOKE-UP
ADR section 2 pin table + run.sh license; FF-IMAGES-PINNED
ADR section 3.1 batched seeding + actual count; FF-SMOKE-SEED
ADR section 3.2 step 5 cleanup_present_in_oss from the public image
ADR section 3.2 throughput + section 3.3 extrapolation with explicit assumptions
ADR section 3.2 step 4 degradation (table sizes, dead_tup, plateau)
ADR section 3.4 list over OSS REST
ADR section 3.4 retry/set-retries over OSS REST
ADR section 3.4 move/return over OSS REST
ADR section 3 second operaton stack, same run.sh subcommands on operaton
ADR section 2 Operaton pin + run.sh license operaton; FF-IMAGES-PINNED
ADR section 3 everything under spikes/; FF-ISOLATION
ADR section 3 disposable volumes + run.sh down; FF-SMOKE-DOWN

runtime_target: локально — Docker на машине разработчика (NF-1, Docker 28.3.0 + Compose v2.38.1 verified). Внешних ресурсов нет: публичный docker pull Apache-2.0-образов; founder/GT-4-провижн не требуется.
